title: L1-L2 facet force under 7.5 Nm pure moments (strain gauges + neural network)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: facet contact load magnitude (compressive) at 7.5 Nm, mean +- SD, n=6 specimens; FL/EX values not split by side

source.sample: 6 fresh-frozen human cadaveric T12-L2 segments screened for degeneration; facet loads at L1-L2 (gauges on L2 superior facets)

protocol.summary: T12-L2 specimens, end vertebrae potted in fixture cups; pure moments 7.5 Nm in FL, EX, right/left AR, right/left LB (standard flexibility test, Crawford 1995): 3 preconditioning cycles at peak load, then quasi-static 1.5 Nm increments to 7.5 Nm, each held 45 s; no preload; facet capsules intact.
how_to_simulate: Fix L2 (caudal cup); T12 cranial cup free, unconstrained
Apply pure moment up to 7.5 Nm in flexion, extension, axial rotation and lateral bending (one side), no preload
Report L1-L2 facet contact force at 7.5 Nm: for AR and LB separately for the contralateral and ipsilateral facet
protocol.notes: Method: four-gauge strain pads on lateral L2 superior articular processes (extra-articular, capsule intact); specimen-specific neural-network models (NeuralWorks Predict) trained on post hoc calibration loads 5-125 N at up to 12 points per facet; load RMSD < 11 N (Table 1). Strain gauges cannot measure tension; values are compressive contact loads.

extraction.from: Results text (FL, EX, AR contralateral); Fig 3 bars (AR ipsilateral, LB both sides)
extraction.uncertainty: +-1 N (digitised; axis 4.56 px/N at 200 dpi; 7 bars with text values matched to within 0.2 N)
extraction.check_notes: Digitised all 9 bars by pixel scan (x0=604 px, 140 N=1242 px). Text-reported bars re-digitised as check: FL 46.1/41.3 (text 46.1+-41.3), EX 51.4/39.1 (51.5+-39.0), AR contra 70.2/43.2 (70.3+-43.2), CF upright 45.4 (11.4% of 400 N = 45.6), CF FL 46.5/41.9 (46.6+-41.9), CF EX 75.3/39.0 (75.4+-39.0). Text values used where given.
